scenes.name: sc_mela_01
scenes.prompt: A simple village fair (मेला) in a jungle clearing: two or three striped cloth stalls on the left, one small ferris wheel far behind, a single line of triangular bunting overhead, a few flat green trees at the back. Wide empty grass and dirt ground across the whole foreground, nothing standing in it. FLAT 2D children's book illustration, simple cartoon vector style. Clean even dark-brown outlines of uniform thickness, FLAT colour fills in a SOFT MUTED palette with only one gentle shadow tone, NO gradients, NO texture, NO painterly brushwork, NO 3D rendering, NO photorealism, NO depth-of-field blur. SIMPLE AND UNCLUTTERED: few objects, large plain shapes, generous empty space. Soft warm daylight, friendly rounded character design with big simple eyes. Made for a 6-year-old to read at a glance. Absolutely NO text, NO words, NO letters or numbers anywhere in the image. Wide 16:9, everything fully inside frame.

scenes.name: sc_mela_09
scenes.prompt:
Use the attached image as the style reference: same flat 2D cartoon style, same soft muted palette, same jungle fair. Evening at the fair, the sun low and orange behind the ferris wheel.

Place exactly four animal pairs at FOUR DIFFERENT DEPTHS, so the picture has near, middle and far - do not put them on one line:
- BOTTOM-LEFT, closest to the viewer and largest: a LION with a full mane and a LIONESS with no mane, resting on the grass facing each other.
- CENTRE-RIGHT, mid-distance and a little smaller: an OX with horns carrying a dhol drum, walking beside a COW.
- FAR LEFT, small, up near the stalls: a PEACOCK with his tail open and a PEAHEN.
- FAR RIGHT, small, near the ferris wheel: two MONKEYS, one holding a red balloon, the other carrying a baby on her chest.

Soft muted storybook colours, not bright. Flat 2D, clean outlines, flat fills, no gradients, no 3D. No text or letters anywhere. Wide 16:9.
